anomalies.description: A white sedan loses control on a snowy road, slides sideways across the lane, and collides with the snowbank on the left shoulder, coming to rest at an angle.
A white sedan loses control on the snowy road, slides sideways across the lane, and collides with the left snowbank, coming to rest at an angle with visible front-end damage.

A red SUV loses control on the snowy road, slides sideways across the lane, and collides with the camera vehicle or comes to an abrupt stop directly in front, causing a sudden violent shake and spray of snow/ice.
A green truck ahead suddenly brakes or stops, and a dark sedan from the left lane collides with its rear-left side. The impact is visible as the sedan’s front end contacts the truck at 43.0–43.5 s.

A yellow vehicle (likely a taxi) collides with a white ambulance at an intersection; the impact is visible as the yellow vehicle's front end strikes the side of the ambulance, causing it to swerve and emit dust/debris.
A head-on collision occurs between two vehicles on a snowy road; one vehicle is struck violently, causing debris and snow to erupt outward.
An orange truck abruptly swerves left across lane markings and collides with a purple-and-white semi-truck traveling in the adjacent lane, causing visible impact and displacement of the orange truck.
